_doc: Outsider Inside — series, papers and layout variants. Read by tools/variety.mjs. Rules: frame.md § Series & Variety.

lab-spiral.label: Spiral lab notebook, ruled box, blue edge

mythe.for: a claim / add-on / promise examined: strike + verdict stamp

labo.for: embryology, lab technique, what really happens to gametes/embryos — real footage is the hero

questions.for: one patient question answered (generic wording, never an identifiable patient)

chiffres.for: a study, a success rate, a comparison — the data is the story

conseils.for: practical take-aways / closing summary — no drug names or doses, never a real prescription

promesse-A.desc: claim top-left full measure, pen strike, evidence below

promesse-B.desc: claim centred in display size, one chisel stroke corner to corner across both lines, evidence as a single line under it

chiffre-A.desc: two figures side by side, hairline between, labels under

chiffre-B.desc: hand-ruled ledger table snapped to the grid, pen circle on the decisive figure

chiffre-C.desc: one hero number on the grid (hard cut, no count-up), label + context beside it, slip bottom-left

verdict-A.desc: stamp right of the figures, slightly overlapping nothing

verdict-B.desc: headline naming what is judged, the stamp pressed over it alone on the page, one evidence line, slip

labo-A.desc: real print laid on the notebook, caption on its margin, notes on the rules beside it

labo-B.desc: real still full-bleed with one slow push-in, paper footage-tab bottom-left, one paper figure card with its citation

question-A.desc: question in italic on the first rules, answer in roman, figures, stamp

retenir-A.desc: dash list on the rules, pen underline on the key line, signature

schema-A.desc: a real scientific drawing (Servier Medical Art / NIH BioArt) as ink plates on the page, one common scale, stages printed in order, typeset labels on the rules, credit line on screen

flux-A.desc: a process in 3–5 boxes, black-ink boxes and connectors drawn by rough.js (seeded per video), typeset labels; from the HyperFrames catalog hw-pipeline, restyled (no boil, no Caveat)

arbre-A.desc: one question card branching into two answer cards with ink connectors; every card text is a sourced fact; from the catalog flowchart, restyled (no cursor, no sticky-note colours)

barres-A.desc: hatched ink bars on the squared grid, axis from 0, heights read from the sourced figures on screen; from the catalog data-chart, restyled

grille-A.desc: 100 ink marks (10×10 schematic icons, or a sorted line-up of bars) with k of them filled; the hero figure with its slip beside it. Schematic only — never a micrograph; label it as a diagram

_aspects: Every reference scene is one index.html that renders 16:9; tools/aspect.mjs writes its 9:16 Shorts twin (shorts/) from the :root[data-aspect="9x16"] rules in the same file.
